    Multiplication in the linearization #

    For a finite ray category P, the element morElt f of k(P) of a morphism f (zero for f = 0) is multiplicative: morElt g * morElt f = morElt (f ≫ g) and morElt g * morElt f = 0 for non-composable f, g; the identities sum to 1. Hence a family of elements of a k-algebra with the same properties extends to an algebra map k(P) → A' (RayQuiver.linLift). Modules over k(P) are thus functors on P sending zero morphisms to zero maps.

    (linRep P k) (rayElt k μ) = morAct k ↑μ.snd.snd
